Cost: 7,500eb (Luxury)
Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)
Option Slots: uses 3

External Body Cyberware. Requires 3 Option Slots. Armors the user's body and head at SP 12. Ablation this armor would take is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0. Compatible with every Subdermal Armor enhancement except Guard. Incompatible with all other Skinweave, Subdermal Armor, and Dragoon Plating. It repairs 1 lost SP at the end of any day in which it loses none.

Foundry notes:

  • Cyberware items carry no SP, so the SP 12 comes as a separate armor item, "Nano-Plating (Armor)", the way the core system splits Subdermal Armor into a cyberware piece and an armor piece. Equip both.
  • The reduced ablation and the daily self-repair are applied by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
